propositions: det_floor.py exceeds the 800-LOC hard cap at 793 lines; the blocking vs never-blocking check boundary provides a call-graph seam with zero edges between the two sets

Four never-blocking checks (p2_resolution, p3_package_existence, p6_ac_quality, p7_destructive) plus their regexes move to new det_advisory.py; det_floor.py re-exports them to preserve all import points and attribute access

det_advisory.py requires module-level bindings for vague_hits_in_line, _lint_verify_command, and _verify_command_strings, which p6_ac_quality calls as bare names; det_floor.py drops these imports since p6 was their only consumer

det_floor.py monkeypatch targets (DET_CHECKS, run_det_floor, est_tokens) and imported helpers (_clarity_score, _count_ac_items, _description_limit) all remain in det_floor.py so existing test mocks continue to reach live code
det_floor.py shrinks from 793 to 566 lines (29% headroom); det_advisory.py grows to 303 lines; both stay within the 200-500 LOC target band
